qc/runs/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r9/raw-evidence-index.json; qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/workspace.cjs (sha256 5c88d7b1...c023, matches index) and results/workspace.json (sha256 49ff6246...b61f, matches index)
evidence: Time-varying/interactive demands in the public ask: live board within 15 s without reload and without closing the open card, wiping a typed note or moving the cursor (instruction.md line 5; hireops_rules.md section 5 lines 117-123); conversation arrival while at newest vs scrolled up, unread counts, seen marks, drafts, earlier-message place keeping, failed send, ended session (instruction.md line 7; rules section 6). Responsive/themed: explicitly not required (instruction.md line 11 'We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'; visual/prompt.md line 14 'Assess desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport. No phone layout or theme switching is required.'), so no resize/toggle exercise is owed. Every time-varying behaviour is driven by explicit actions and waits rather than a still first paint: functional V (prompt.md line 47) keeps Rafael's page on J1, has Mei act in an independent context, and says 'Without reloading or clicking in this page, wait up to 15 seconds (a wait-for call, or snapshots; accept what is present at the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds)' -> hro_live_board (judge.toml lines 284-291). U (prompt.md line 41) 'Every reading in U is made without reloading, navigating or clicking in Rafael's page: wait up to 15 seconds after the other person acts' -> hro_unread_counts (329-336), hro_seen (347-354), hro_unread_scrolled_up (338-345, scrolls up, independent Noor sends, reads place/notice/count before and after going to it). T -> hro_msg_exchange (293-300, reply on open conversation within 15 s without reload), hro_msg_compose (Shift+Enter/Enter/focus), hro_drafts (switch views, reload), hro_thread_earlier (repeated load-earlier). C -> hro_stale_refused (194-201) board catches up within 15 s without reload. L -> hro_refused_put_back reads document.activeElement. D -> real restart_app. Polish (polish/prompt.md line 14: 'After that action do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page until the update has been seen or 15 seconds have passed. Read document.activeElement, field values and scroll offsets with page.evaluate') -> hro_pol_live_board (polish/judge.toml lines 17-24: opens card, types unsaved note, scrolls page or board container -- with a fallback 'if neither scrolls at this viewport, add cards until one does' -- waits for independent move, checks details open, note text, activeElement, scroll, typing appends), hro_pol_live_thread (26-33: typed reply, focus, view at newest after arrival), hro_pol_earlier_place (35-42: getBoundingClientRect before/after load-earlier), hro_pol_failed_send (44-51: route abort/setOffline for one send), hro_pol_session_resume (53-60: second-tab sign-out, Enter on stale page). Visual is read-only but still opens a card's details and the long conversation (visual/prompt.md line 14). Compared with the template (template polish/prompt.md is a generic first-load gate), the task adds the concrete wait/act/read steps this row asks for. The 'first snapshot at or after 15 seconds' rule avoids one-second timing distinctions. Scripted golden evidence (not a judge run) confirms the reference supports these behaviours: workspace.json results 17 'live board ... open card, note draft and focus kept' passed, arrival_ms 804; 18 'arrival while reading keeps draft, focus and scroll and is not marked read until viewed' passed; 19 seen/unread update live passed; page_errors []. Residual P3 gap: the explicit no-reload/15-second wait in U is scoped to 'Rafael's page'; hro_seen's second half reads seen marks on Tomas's (candidate) page after Bill and then Rafael open the conversation (prompt.md line 41; judge.toml line 353) with no explicit wait-up-to-15-s / no-reload instruction for that page, so a judge could snapshot immediately or reload. The criterion's own 'Fails if seen is shown ... only after a reload' partially guards the reload direction. Secondary P3: the brief's 'whether I am reading or halfway through a reply, never touch my draft' while scrolled up is not separately exercised (hro_pol_live_thread types only at newest; hro_unread_scrolled_up has no draft) -- the general draft-preservation case is covered, so this is narrow. Runtime gap: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; no configured judge transcript shows the judges actually performed these clicks/waits, so the 'actually' half of the row is unmeasured. browser_run_code_unsafe availability in the pinned playwright-mcp (needed for independent contexts behind every live-update row) is also not demonstrated by a judge run here.
counterexample: Conforming app whose candidate page polls every 10 s: in U the judge sees Bill open the conversation and immediately snapshots Tomas's page (no wait is prescribed for that page), sees 'not seen', and scores hro_seen 0 as 'never'. Conversely a broken candidate page that only refreshes seen marks on reload could pass if the judge reloads Tomas's page before reading. Narrow: a broken app that clears the reply draft only when a message arrives while the reader is scrolled up passes both hro_pol_live_thread (at newest) and hro_unread_scrolled_up (no draft check).
suggested_fix: Extend U's wait sentence to every observed page ('in the page being read -- Rafael's or Tomas's -- make no reload, navigation or click and wait up to 15 s, accepting the first snapshot at or after 15 s'), optionally add 'with an unsent reply typed' to the scrolled-up leg, and obtain a configured judge run whose transcript shows the waits, scrolls and independent-context actions.
